title: Split refunds return one cent less than the customer was promised
details:
Support raised this after three separate customer complaints in a week.

A customer on order #55120 was refunded USD 10.00. The order had three lines of USD 5.00 each. The
refund confirmation email said 10.00, the customer's card was credited 9.99, and our per-line report
shows 3.33 + 3.33 + 3.33.

It is one cent, but it is one cent that does not reconcile: the refund total and the sum of the line
allocations disagree, so the daily settlement file does not balance and finance has been correcting it by
hand every morning.

It seems to happen whenever the refund does not divide evenly across the lines. Refunds that split
cleanly (10.00 across two 5.00 lines) are fine. The missing amount can also go the other way — we have one
case where the allocations summed to MORE than the refund.

Whatever the split is, the per-line allocations have to add up to exactly the amount refunded.
